snippet.title: Queendomia: Black & Pink
snippet.description:
Welcome to the Early Access version of my Unity game!

This is a solo passion project that I've been developing with a strong focus on visuals, atmosphere, and interactive gameplay. The game features detailed character models, expressive animations, and immersive environments, with many more features planned throughout development.

This project is actively being developed, and your feedback helps shape future updates.

If you enjoyed the video, consider leaving a like, subscribing, and sharing your thoughts in the comments.

Thank you for watching!

🔗 queendomia.itch.io
